messages:
Priya: heads up — PR #22599 is ready for merge but needs runtime + platform + infra + security sign-off. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/22599

Sanjay: looking now. main changes are eviction header + batch-kernel tweak? can you paste a short summary?

Priya: summary: 1) change eviction header propagation to avoid stale KV, 2) dynamic batch sizing flag behind feature-flag, 3) update network egress rule for private deploys. tests + unit coverage included.

Alex: @Priya this touches the hot path — I can do a perf skim (ETA ~2h). do we have a canary plan spelled out?

Priya: yes — canary plan is in the PR description. TL;DR: 10% traffic on a dedicated pool for 24h, automatic fallback to previous model variant on error, and rollout pause on latency/regression alerts. @ops-bot can we reserve a canary window tomorrow 03:00-06:00 UTC?

ops-bot: canary window requested: 03:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow. pending infra host allocation approval.

Ashley: tagging infra/security: @SRE-Team @Security-Team — need quick thumbs on networking + KMS policy changes. what approvals do we need besides manual review?

Sanjay: infra note: egress change requires SOC/network review. please include the target CIDR in the PR checklist and add a short changelog entry. also need host allocation estimate (count + GPU type).

Security-Bot: automated SAST passed. manual review required for KMS policy changes. @Ashley please attach the KMS policy diff and a short rationale.

Priya: attached KMS policy diff in the PR description (see “kms-diff.patch”). @Alex please flag any perf regressions. plan is to merge after runtime + platform + infra + security are all +1; canary to start within ~12h of merge.

Alex: skimming locally — no obvious perf regressions on small seq len tests. leaving a performance comment in the PR. i'll formally approve once CI is green.

Sanjay: adding infra checklist comment with host allocation: 4 x a100-equivalent for initial canary, probe endpoints + healthchecks, will follow up in the PR thread. provisional +1 from infra ops side.

Ashley: security request: small key-rotation doc update required in the PR (one paragraph). once that's in i'll give a full +1.

Priya: copied — will add the key-rotation blurb now. thanks. if everyone is +1 by EOD i'll schedule merge in the midnight window to minimize impact.

Priya: pinging for final checks @Alex @Sanjay @Ashley — any blockers?

Alex: CI green, approving now. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: infra approved, allocating hosts and setting up the canary pool.

Ashley: security approved after the doc update. leaving +1 in PR.

Priya: merged — canary started. i'll post the canary dashboard link + a short metric summary in ~30m. thanks all for quick reviews!
